awkward: The box was an awkward shape, so it would not fit in the boot.
Mum said the narrow stairs were awkward for carrying a big sofa.
I felt awkward when I forgot the words of the song at the party.
forty: Mum baked thirty biscuits and ten more, which makes forty.
Our bus ride to the seaside took forty minutes.
Twenty and twenty make forty altogether.
symbol: On the map, a little tree is the symbol for a wood.
What does this symbol on the washing label mean?
The plus sign is a symbol we use in sums.
system: The library uses a computer system to keep track of borrowed books.
Is there a good system for sorting the washing?
The train system is very busy on Monday mornings!
rhyme: Moon and spoon make a perfect rhyme!
Mum sang a nursery rhyme to the baby at bedtime.
I made up a short rhyme for my sister's birthday card.
rhythm: Can you clap the rhythm of your own name?
The train wheels clacked in a regular rhythm along the track.
The dancers moved with a steady rhythm.
yacht: A large white sail on the yacht caught the wind.
Which yacht will cross the finish line first?
The yacht rocked gently beside the jetty in the harbour.
queue: We waited in a long queue to buy tickets for the show.
Nobody should push in front when you stand in a queue.
Is the queue for the slide very long today?
muscle: A cat uses every muscle when it jumps onto a high shelf.
Which muscle in your arm do you use to lift a bag?
Opening a stiff jar takes a bit of muscle.
bruise: The peach had a soft bruise where it fell from the basket.
Mum cut the brown bruise off the apple before lunch.
A bruise on a pear turns dark after a few days.
